title: Transmission temperature signal indicates extreme cold
plainEnglishMeaning: The PCM received a transmission-temperature signal below the sensor's plausible operating range, commonly indicating an open circuit or connection problem.
enableCriteria: The reproduced Roadmaster chart states below -40 °C for five seconds.
failureCriteria: Transmission-fluid-temperature input remains at the extreme-cold end of its range.
pcmFallbackAction: Do not illuminate the malfunction indicator; substitute a 90 °C transmission-temperature value.
driverSymptoms: Shift timing or torque-converter-clutch operation may be affected by the substituted temperature value.

likelyCauses.cause: Transmission temperature sensor out of calibration

falsePositiveConditions: A disconnected sensor produces a signal similar to impossible cold temperature.
confirmatoryTests: Confirm that the sensor connector has the PCM reference voltage.
Check the signal and ground circuits for an open connection.
Compare sensor resistance with the applicable temperature-to-resistance table.
